title: Brazilian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with grilled chicken, orange-infused slaw, and wrapped in a crispy Brazilian-style wrap.

ingredients.name: Brazilian Wrap
ingredients.notes: Found in most international or health food stores

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together orange juice, infused oil, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture on both sides of the chicken breasts.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a separate bowl, mix together shredded carrots and red cabbage.
In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise and a squeeze of orange juice.
Add the mayonnaise mixture to the carrot mixture and toss to combine.
Warm the Brazilian wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a grilled chicken breast on each wrap, followed by a spoonful of the orange-infused slaw.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
